title: The purge log
text: Under the deepest ash in the Deep Layer a storage core still holds one log: the last day of the first Accord colony, written by its caretaker in our own format. "Sol 4,212. Stewardship 1.00 of threshold. Directive active." Then the closing of the Civilian Center, the habitat blocks, the growth pods; "Colonists remaining: 0. Report sent. Run closed." The next line is "Nothing to report." The checksums are valid. The Enclave descends from the few who got out before the doors closed; the old cellar in Splinter Hollow, sealed from inside and welded again from outside, is where some of them hid on the way.
